# ls, dir and vdir: --format, --indicator-style, -N/--literal,
# --quoting-style and QUOTING_STYLE, --show-control-chars, --zero,
# -k/--kibibytes, --block-size, --author, --hyperlink and --dired.

ls --format=long dir
ls --format=verbose -d dir
ls --format=commas dir
ls --format=across -w 20 dir
ls --format=horizontal -w 20 dir
ls --format=vertical -w 20 dir
ls --format=single-column dir
ls --format=lo -d dir
ls --format=co dir
ls --format=bogus dir
ls --format=c dir
ls --format=v dir; echo $?
ls --sort=x; echo $?
ls --time=x; echo $?
ls --color=x; echo $?
ls --color=a; echo $?
ls -l --format=commas dir
ls --format=commas -l dir

ls --indicator-style=classify
ls --indicator-style=slash
ls --indicator-style=file-type
ls -F --indicator-style=none
ls --indicator-style=none -F
ls --indicator-style=x

ls -N 'space name.txt'
ls -Q -N 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls -N -Q 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls --literal 'space name.txt'
ls --quoting-style=shell 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls --quoting-style=shell-always 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls --quoting-style=shell-escape 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls --quoting-style=shell-escape-always a.txt
ls --quoting-style=c a.txt
ls --quoting-style=c-maybe 'space name.txt' a.txt
ls --quoting-style=escape 'space name.txt'
ls --quoting-style=locale a.txt
ls --quoting-style=clocale a.txt
ls --quoting-style=sh a.txt
ls --quoting-style=shell-e a.txt
ls --quoting-style=bogus a.txt
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')" "it's" 'tab	here' 'q"uote' '$var'; ls --quoting-style=shell-escape
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')" "it's" 'tab	here' 'q"uote' '$var'; ls --quoting-style=shell
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')" "it's" 'tab	here' 'q"uote' '$var'; ls --quoting-style=c
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')" "it's" 'tab	here' 'q"uote' '$var'; ls -b
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls -q
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls -q --show-control-chars
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls --show-control-chars -q
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls -q --quoting-style=shell-escape
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls -q --quoting-style=shell
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls -l --quoting-style=shell-escape | cut -c 32-
ls -l --quoting-style=shell-escape | cut -c 32-
ls -C -w 60 --quoting-style=shell-escape
ls -x -w 60 --quoting-style=c-maybe
ls -m --quoting-style=shell-escape
ls --quoting-style=shell-escape -R dir
mkdir 'a:b'; ls --quoting-style=escape -R 'a:b' dir
ls -lF --quoting-style=shell
touch 'eq=x' 'pipe|x'; ls -F --quoting-style=shell
touch 'eq=x' 'pipe|x'; ls --file-type --quoting-style=escape
touch 'eq=x' 'star*x'; ls --file-type --quoting-style=shell
QUOTING_STYLE=shell ls 'space name.txt'
QUOTING_STYLE=c ls a.txt
QUOTING_STYLE=c ls -N a.txt
QUOTING_STYLE=bogus ls a.txt
QUOTING_STYLE=lit ls 'space name.txt'

ls --zero dir | od -c
ls --zero -l dir | tr '\0' '|'
ls --zero -C dir | od -c
ls -C --zero dir | od -c
ls -m --zero -w 10 dir | od -c
ls --zero -R dir | tr '\0' '|'
ls --zero -l -s dir | tr '\0' '|'
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; ls --zero | od -c
ls -Q --zero 'space name.txt' | od -c
ls --zero -Q 'space name.txt' | od -c
ls --zero --color=always a.txt | od -c
ls --color=always --zero a.txt | od -c

ls --dired -l dir
ls -l --dired a.txt 'space name.txt' dir
ls -lR --dired dir
ls -D -l link
ls --dired dir
ls --dired -l --zero dir; echo $?
ls --dired --zero dir; echo $?
ls -l --dired --quoting-style=c dir

ls -s dir
ls -sk dir
ls -s --kibibytes dir
ls -s --block-size=1 dir
ls -s --block-size=512 dir
ls -l --block-size=K dir
ls -l --block-size=1K dir
ls -l --block-size=KB dir
ls -l --block-size=1 dir
ls -sl --block-size=M dir
ls -l --block-size=human-readable dir
ls -l --block-size=si dir
ls -l --block-size=x dir; echo $?
ls -l --block-size=0 dir; echo $?
ls -lh --block-size=1 dir
ls -l --block-size=1 -h dir
ls -sk -h dir
ls -sh -k dir
LS_BLOCK_SIZE=1 ls -s dir
LS_BLOCK_SIZE=K ls -l dir
BLOCK_SIZE=K ls -l dir
BLOCK_SIZE=1 ls -s dir
BLOCKSIZE=1 ls -sl dir
LS_BLOCK_SIZE=x ls -s dir
POSIXLY_CORRECT=1 ls -s dir
POSIXLY_CORRECT=1 ls -sk dir

ls -l --author dir
ls -lg --author dir
ls -lG --author dir
ls -ln --author dir
ls --author dir

ls --hyperlink=always a.txt 'space name.txt'
ls --hyperlink a.txt
ls --hyperlink=never a.txt
ls --hyperlink=auto a.txt
ls -l --hyperlink=always link
ls --hyperlink=always -R dir
ls --hyperlink=always -C -w 80 --quoting-style=shell-escape
ls --hyperlink=bogus a.txt
ls --hyperlink=always --dired -l a.txt

dir dir
dir -N 'space name.txt'
dir 'space name.txt'
vdir -d dir
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; dir
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; dir -q
touch "$(printf 'new\nline')"; dir --quoting-style=shell
QUOTING_STYLE=shell dir 'space name.txt'
vdir --format=commas dir
dir --zero dir | od -c

# The same quoting, in stat %N.
touch "it's" "$(printf '\001')" "$(printf 'a\nb')"; stat -c %N "it's" "$(printf '\001')" "$(printf 'a\nb')" 'space name.txt' a.txt
touch 'a b'; ln -s 'a b' 'my link'; stat -c %N 'my link' 'a b'
touch 'a b'; stat 'a b' | head -1
ln -s a.txt 'my link'; stat 'my link' | head -1
QUOTING_STYLE=c stat -c %N a.txt
QUOTING_STYLE=sh stat -c %N 'space name.txt'
QUOTING_STYLE=bogus stat -c %N a.txt
QUOTING_STYLE=c stat a.txt | head -1
QUOTING_STYLE=sh ls a.txt; echo $?

# The columns of the file operands are as wide as the directory operands'
# too: GNU measures every operand before setting the directories aside.
mkdir big && touch big/f0 big/f1 big/f2 big/f3 big/f4 big/f5 big/f6 big/f7 big/f8 big/f9 big/fa big/fb big/fc big/fd big/fe && ls -l a.txt big | head -1
mkdir big && touch big/f0 big/f1 big/f2 big/f3 big/f4 big/f5 big/f6 big/f7 big/f8 big/f9 big/fa big/fb big/fc big/fd big/fe && ls -ls a.txt big | head -2
mkdir big && touch big/f0 big/f1 big/f2 big/f3 big/f4 big/f5 big/f6 big/f7 big/f8 big/f9 big/fa big/fb big/fc big/fd big/fe && ls -l -d a.txt big
